items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: we played about two hours trying to get something that Dave Capp would take.

ctx.x: But anyway, nevertheless, the way fate put it, we played about two hours trying to get something that Dave Capp would take. He kept telling us, "Fellas, I can't make no money with that." So he finally says,-- I had forgotten I had Walter Brown there, see?
So all those good band numbers he knew, he didn't think he could market them, huh?
